items.title: Block (XYZ) Opens Cash App Score To Outside Lenders For The First Time
items.summary: Block (NYSE: XYZ) has launched Cash App Score to external lenders through a new partnership with Nova Credit. The deal gives lenders access to Cash App’s proprietary cash flow based credit score for use in underwriting. The move extends Block’s credit scoring reach beyond its own ecosystem and into Nova Credit’s lending platform.
